svg.title: A point, an arrow, and an angle
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “A point, an arrow, and an angle” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing the vector (3,4) drawn both as a red dot and as a blue arrow from the origin with its 3-4-5 right triangle and the norm worked out as five; two arrows u and v with the angle between them marked and the dot product formula written out with cosine theta circled; three document vectors showing that a short and a long document about cats point the same way while a tax-law document is ninety degrees away, with the Euclidean distance between the two cat documents struck through in red; a unit circle with the same arrows normalised onto it; and two histograms of pairwise distances that are wide at two dimensions and collapse to a thin spike at a thousand.
svg.text: A point, an arrow, and an angle
draw it from memory, then compare
